title: Local pi workers need the ticfac harness installed, like local claude workers need claude
description: Today a local pi-durable worker runs node <repo>/harness/src/local/main.ts (internal/exec/subprocess/executor.go harnessDir(), TICFAC_HARNESS_DIR override), so it only works inside the ticfac repository. Decision (operator, 2026-10-07): treat the harness exactly like the claude CLI for local claude workers — a prerequisite installed on the machine. Publish ticfac's harness (harness/, pi-durable pinned inside) as an npm package installed globally (name to be chosen); the binary records the harness version it is compatible with; the local executor resolves the globally installed harness (TICFAC_HARNESS_DIR still overrides, and the ticfac repo's own harness/ stays usable for development); ticfac doctor checks presence and version and prints the install command, the way it does for claude; the release workflow publishes the package with each release (y9v); ticfac upgrade (y9v) updates both.
acceptance_criteria: In a repository that is not ticfac, on a machine with the released binaries plus the globally installed harness package, a local pi-durable run dispatches and completes a worker; doctor names a missing or mismatched harness with its install command; tests cover resolution and the version check; make gate passes
